panels.label: Steering
panels.description: Lateral control, lane changes, and steering behavior

items.title: Enable Modular Assistive Driving System (MADS)
items.description: Allows steering assistance to stay active independently of cruise control. Off restores normal combined engagement and disengagement.

items.title: Toggle with Main Cruise
items.description: Allows the main cruise button to enable steering assistance. Turning this off prevents steering engagement on cars without a separate LFA/LKAS button.

items.title: Unified Engagement Mode (UEM)
items.description: Engages steering assistance together with cruise control. Steering remains active until you turn MADS off or shut down the car.
items.details: Turning this setting off restores separate steering and cruise engagement.

items.title: Steering Mode on Brake Pedal
items.description: Choose whether steering assistance continues or pauses when you press the brake pedal.

sections.title: Blinker Control
sections.description: Lateral pause behavior during turn signals

items.title: Pause Lateral Control with Blinker
items.description: Pauses steering assistance when the turn signal is on below the selected speed. Off keeps steering assistance active.

sub_items.title: Minimum Speed to Pause Lateral Control
Post-Blinker Delay
sub_items.description: Delay before lateral control resumes after the turn signal ends.

sections.title: Torque Control
sections.description: Steering torque tuning and lateral control method

items.title: Enforce Torque Lateral Control
items.description: Uses torque-based steering control instead of the vehicle's default controller. Off restores the default controller.

items.title: Lateral Jerk Torque Controller
items.description: Anticipates changes in steering to reduce abrupt corrections through turns. Works with Self-Tune and custom tuning.

items.title: Self-Tune
items.description: Learns torque-controller tuning while you drive, including on vehicles that do not use it by default.

items.title: Less Restrict Settings for Self-Tune (Beta)
items.description: Allows Self-Tune to learn from a wider range of driving conditions. Off uses the standard learning criteria.

items.title: Enable Custom Tuning
items.description: Uses your acceleration-factor and friction values instead of the default torque tune. Manual Real-Time Tuning also applies them instead of learned values.

items.title: Manual Real-Time Tuning
items.description: Uses your fixed torque-tuning values instead of Self-Tune's learned values. Off allows learned values to be used again.

items.title: Torque Control Tune Version
items.description: Select the version of Torque Control Tune to use.

sections.title: Lane Change
sections.description: Automatic lane change timing and behavior

items.title: Auto Lane Change by Blinker
items.description: Starts a lane change after the selected delay without a steering nudge; Nudge keeps manual confirmation. Signal only when it is safe to change lanes.
items.details: You remain responsible for checking surrounding traffic before a lane change.

items.title: Block Lane Change: Road Edge Detection
items.description: Blocks lane change when the model sees a road edge on the side you signal.

items.title: Auto Lane Change: Delay with Blind Spot
items.description: Adds a lane-change delay when blind-spot monitoring detects another vehicle.
items.details: Off removes this extra delay.

sections.title: nrdr
sections.description: Customize steering, cruise control, device behavior, and driver monitoring.

items.title: Apply Suggested Settings
items.description: Applies the recommended steering settings for your vehicle. Turning this off leaves the applied settings unchanged.

items.title: Force Update
items.description: Download and install the latest update, then restart the device while the car is off.
items.details: The switch turns off once the request is accepted; this does not cancel the update. Follow progress in Remote Action Status.

items.title: Prevent Automatic Shutdown
items.description: Keeps the device on after the car is turned off, bypassing automatic shutdown and battery protection; this can drain the car battery.
items.details: Turning this off restores the shutdown timer and battery protection after 60 seconds. Manual Power Off remains available.

items.title: Controller Type
items.description: Choose the steering controller: PIF uses your feedback tune, while Firmware Controller uses a vehicle-specific calibration.
items.details: Requires the exact modified steering firmware build shown in Controller Type on the device. Older builds with the same version name are incompatible.

items.title: Predictive Lateral Stiction
items.description: Reduces steering force as the wheel reaches its target, then holds it steady until another correction is needed. Off uses the normal steering response.
items.details: Pauses during driver steering input and lane changes. Steering faults and control limits take priority.

items.title: Use Device Yaw Correction
items.description: Adds a small steering correction based on the car's measured motion. Off uses PIF control alone.
items.details: Applies to PIF control and pauses during optimized lane changes. Firmware Controller uses its own correction.

items.title: Optimized Lane Changes
items.description: Adjusts the steering response during lane changes to reduce abrupt corrections. Off keeps the normal steering tune throughout the maneuver.

items.title: [0-25MPH] Proportional
items.description: Corrects steering error as it occurs.
items.details: Corrects steering error as it occurs.

items.title: [0-25MPH] Integral
items.description: Builds correction over time for persistent steering error, such as an alignment bias.
items.details: Builds correction over time for persistent steering error, such as an alignment bias.

items.title: [0-25MPH] Derivative
items.description: Resists rapid steering-wheel movement to reduce overshoot. Set to 0% to disable; optimized lane changes temporarily bypass it.

items.title: [0-25MPH] Feedforward
items.description: Supplies anticipated steering torque before an error occurs.

items.title: [25-50MPH] Proportional
items.description: Corrects steering error as it occurs.

items.title: [25-50MPH] Integral
items.description: Builds correction over time for persistent steering error, such as an alignment bias.

items.title: [25-50MPH] Derivative
items.description: Resists rapid steering-wheel movement to reduce overshoot. Set to 0% to disable; optimized lane changes temporarily bypass it.

items.title: [25-50MPH] Feedforward
items.description: Supplies anticipated steering torque before an error occurs.

items.title: [50+MPH] Proportional
items.description: Corrects steering error as it occurs.

items.title: [50+MPH] Integral
items.description: Builds correction over time for persistent steering error, such as an alignment bias.

items.title: [50+MPH] Derivative
items.description: Resists rapid steering-wheel movement to reduce overshoot. Set to 0% to disable; optimized lane changes temporarily bypass it.

items.title: [50+MPH] Feedforward
items.description: Supplies anticipated steering torque before an error occurs.

items.title: Center Boost
items.description: Adds steering correction near the straight-ahead position to help maintain the planned path.
items.details: Applies to PIF control within the selected angle and speed range. Firmware Controller is unchanged.

items.title: Center Boost Threshold (deg)
items.description: Sets how far the steering wheel can turn from center before Center Boost stops applying.

items.title: Center Boost Minimum Speed
items.description: Sets the minimum speed for Center Boost. The boost remains available at higher speeds.
items.details: Center Boost gradually takes effect above this speed.

items.title: Lane Centering Method
items.description: Choose Sunny or Star lane-centering assistance. Off follows the driving model's path without added lane-centering corrections.
items.details: Sunny blends lane guidance into the model path; Star adds a separate steering correction. Sunny requires a custom model.

items.title: Minimum Lane Centering Speed
items.description: Sets the speed at which lane-centering assistance starts. It fades out below this speed to avoid repeated switching.
items.details: Once active, assistance fades out 3 mph below the selected speed, with a lower limit of about 11 mph.

items.title: Fade on Turn Signal
items.description: Pauses lane-centering corrections while the turn signal is on. Lane changes always pause these corrections, even with this setting off.

items.title: Center Offset
items.description: Shift the target left or right of the detected lane center. The controller reduces the offset in a narrow lane.

items.title: Lane-Centering Strength
items.description: Sets how strongly Star favors the lane center over the model's path. Zero follows the model path without added lane-centering correction.
items.details: Higher values favor the lane center more strongly, subject to lane confidence and steering limits. Model Break-In can reduce the correction.

items.title: Model Break-In
items.description: Lets Star yield to a confident model path that differs from the lane center. Higher values allow more correction to be removed; zero disables this behavior.
items.details: Adjusts when the model can take priority without changing the selected lane-centering strength.

items.title: Enable Hybrid Steer Ratio
items.description: Uses source A near center and blends into source B as the steering wheel turns. Off uses source A alone and preserves both selections.
items.details: The transition spans 5 degrees from the selected starting angle, in either direction.

items.title: Ratio A — Near Center / Single Source
items.description: Choose the steering-ratio source used near center, or at all angles when Hybrid is off.
items.details: Manual uses your entered ratios, Comma uses its learned ratio, Measured uses recorded vehicle data, and Firmware uses a matching steering-rack profile.

items.title: Blend Starts At
items.description: Sets the steering-wheel angle where the blend begins, in either direction. Source B takes over fully 5 degrees later.

items.title: Ratio B — Beyond the Blend
items.description: Choose the steering-ratio source used beyond the blend range. Turning the wheel back toward center blends back into source A.

items.title: Manual Override On-Center Ratio
items.description: Sets the manual steering ratio near center. Higher values request more steering-wheel movement for the same curve.

items.title: Manual Override Final Ratio
items.description: Sets the manual steering ratio near the end of the wheel's travel.
items.details: The ratio blends smoothly from the on-center value using the vehicle's steering profile. Vehicles without a matching profile retain their stock ratio.

items.title: Driver Override Threshold (During Straights)
items.description: Sets the driver steering force needed to override assistance near the straight-ahead position. Higher values require more force.
items.details: Applies within the Center Boost angle range. Use the same value as the curves threshold for a uniform override response.

items.title: Driver Override Threshold (During Curves)
items.description: Sets the driver steering force needed to override assistance outside the straight-ahead range. Higher values require more force.
items.details: Applies at all angles when the Center Boost angle range is disabled.

items.title: Assist Pass-Through
items.description: Reduces steering assistance when you take over to make manual steering feel smoother. Off keeps the normal override response.

items.title: Override Torque Fade Down
items.description: Controls how quickly steering torque fades out when driver override begins.

items.title: Override Torque Fade Up
items.description: Controls how quickly steering torque fades back in after driver override ends.

items.title: Override Torque Retain
items.description: Sets how much steering assistance remains after the override fade-out. Zero removes it completely.

items.title: Low Pass Filter (tau)
items.description: Smooths steering commands across all three speed ranges. Off disables filtering without changing your saved values.
items.details: Higher values add smoothing and delay; excessive delay can cause steering oscillations. Zero disables filtering for an individual speed range.

items.title: Low Pass Filter Tau (Below 25mph)
items.description: Sets steering smoothing below 25 mph, in seconds. Higher values add smoothing and delay; zero disables smoothing in this range.

items.title: Standard Tau (25-50mph)
items.description: Sets steering smoothing from 25 to 50 mph, in seconds. Higher values add smoothing and delay; zero disables smoothing in this range.

items.title: Highway Tau (50mph+)
items.description: Sets steering smoothing at 50 mph and above, in seconds. Higher values add smoothing and delay; zero disables smoothing in this range.

items.title: Legacy Steer Delta Rate Limiter
items.description: Limits how quickly steering force can change. Off removes this additional rate limit without changing the saved limits.
items.details: Lower limits produce a slower steering response and can add lag.

items.title: Steer Delta Up
items.description: Sets how quickly steering force can increase when the rate limiter is on. Lower values add lag.

items.title: Steer Delta Down
items.description: Sets how quickly steering force can decrease when the rate limiter is on. Lower values add lag.

items.title: Live Learning Gas
items.description: Uses MVL's adaptive acceleration, braking, and driving profiles. Off returns to custom longitudinal control while preserving learned values and saved tuning.
items.details: Econ retains its gentler nrdr profile; speed-limit and curve-speed settings remain independent. Changes apply next drive.

items.title: Reset Live Learning Gas
items.description: Resets learned Honda gas and wind compensation on this device. Brake tuning, PID settings, and the learning switch are unchanged.
items.details: Resetting wind compensation may change when braking begins. Run while parked with the ignition off; the status shows when the reset finishes.

items.title: PCM Speed-Error Deadzone
items.description: Reduces small speed corrections in Experimental Civic PCM control; zero disables it.
items.details: The deadzone grows from zero at standstill to your selected value at 9 m/s (about 20 mph), without delaying brake requests or stopping.

items.title: Honda Nidec: ECU-Matched PCM Command Shaping
items.description: Adjusts PCM acceleration and the transition to braking using ECU-Matched or Experimental control. Off restores standard PCM control.
items.details: Experimental supports Civic MVL learning and bypasses Wind Brake without changing its saved setting. Applies next drive.

items.title: Wind Brake
items.description: Reduces brake demand to account for estimated air resistance. Off removes this compensation; Experimental PCM shaping ignores it without changing your saved choice.
items.details: Changes apply next drive and do not affect gas compensation.

items.title: Keep Feedforward Static
items.description: Keeps feedforward strength unchanged when adjusting the PID scale. Off scales feedforward with the rest of the tune.
items.details: Affects longitudinal tuning only; steering feedforward has separate settings.

items.title: Full Nidec Brake Authority
items.description: Allows the full available brake-command range. Off restores the standard brake-command limit.
items.details: Applies when the active controller supports this setting.

items.title: Roen Nidec Acceleration Limits
items.description: Uses Roen's acceleration limits and full low-speed pedal response. Off restores the normal acceleration limits.
items.details: Applies to Nidec pedal control with Live Learning Gas off.

items.title: Honda Bosch-A Radar (experimental)
items.description: Uses factory radar for lead detection with stock ACC or Alpha Long. Alpha Long does not restore factory emergency braking (AEB/CMBS).
items.details: Experimental radar support: disable it if detected vehicles are shown incorrectly.

items.title: Honda Dashboard Variant B
items.description: Saves the dashboard variant with four dashed lane lines. This setting currently has no effect.
items.details: Reserved for a future dashboard speed-display adjustment.

items.title: Distance 1 / Aggressive PID Scale
items.description: Adjusts acceleration and braking feedback strength for the Aggressive profile. 100% keeps the base tune.
items.details: Applies with a pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas off; otherwise the base scale is used.

items.title: Distance 2 / Standard PID Scale
items.description: Adjusts acceleration and braking feedback strength for the Standard profile. 100% keeps the base tune.
items.details: Applies with a pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas off; otherwise the base scale is used.

items.title: Distance 3 / Relaxed PID Scale
items.description: Adjusts acceleration and braking feedback strength for the Relaxed profile. 100% keeps the base tune.
items.details: Applies with a pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas off; otherwise the base scale is used.

items.title: Distance 4 / Econ PID Scale
items.description: Adjusts acceleration and braking feedback strength for the Econ profile. 100% keeps the base tune.
items.details: Applies with a pedal interceptor and Live Learning Gas off; otherwise the base scale is used.

items.title: Cruise Mismatch Correction
items.description: Adjusts the cruise target when the car consistently drives above or below the set speed. Lower the value if it runs too fast; raise it if it runs too slowly.
items.details: 100% leaves the target unchanged.

items.title: Extra Stopped Lead Gap
items.description: Adds space behind the vehicle ahead while creeping or stopped. Zero keeps the normal gap without changing the selected following-time profile.
items.details: Applies on the next engagement; actual clearance depends on lead detection and braking.

items.title: Stopping Decel Rate
items.description: Limits how quickly braking builds as the car comes to a stop.

items.title: Stop Accel
items.description: Sets the braking target used to hold the car at a stop.

items.title: Planner Stopping Rate
items.description: Sets how quickly the planned braking target increases when stopping.

items.title: vEgo Stopping
items.description: Sets the speed below which stopping control takes over, in m/s.

items.title: vEgo Starting
items.description: Sets the speed above which the car is treated as moving again, in m/s.

items.title: First Reminder Timing
items.description: Adjusts the delay before the first attention reminder: higher values wait longer, lower values warn sooner, and 100% uses standard timing.
items.details: Driver monitoring stays enabled, with the same intervals between later warnings. Changes apply after reboot.

items.title: Engagement Sounds
items.description: Choose current or June 2026 engagement sounds with their matching volume levels. Other alerts and Quiet Mode are unchanged.
items.details: Applies to the next engagement, disengagement, or engagement-refused chime.

items.title: Confidence Ball
items.description: Shows the confidence ball on the driving screen. Off hides it and stops its animation.

items.title: C4 Developer Sidebar
items.description: Shows the developer sidebar with the confidence ball fixed beside it. Off hides the sidebar and returns the ball to its original animated position.
items.details: Uses your selected Developer UI layout; the confidence ball stays hidden if its own switch is off.

items.title: Injection Test (Caution!)
items.description: Multiplies the lateral PID output scale by 999% for diagnostic testing. Can cause abrupt steering; do not use on public roads.
items.details: Off restores the normal output scale.

items.title: Alternative Dashboard Speed Design
items.description: Choose what appears in the dashboard's set-speed display: cruise set speed, lead speed, GPS speed, or cluster speed.
items.details: Stock restores the usual set-speed display; alternate displays require openpilot cruise control.

items.title: Alternative Dashboard Distance Design
items.description: Choose distance bars that show the normal personality, lead proximity, or acceleration and braking.
items.details: Alternate designs remain visible while disengaged. Stock restores the normal personality bars.

items.title: Clear Dashboard Fault Codes
items.description: Hides camera-related dashboard fault indicators and silences the factory forward-collision warning chime. Off restores those warnings; this does not repair or clear the underlying faults.
items.details: Intended for vehicles with a missing or failed factory camera.

items.title: Spoof Camera Messages
items.description: Prevents the automatic high-beam fault caused by a missing or failed camera. Leave off if the factory camera works.
items.details: Does not repair the camera or restore its functions.

items.title: Cruise Button Sub-Mode
items.description: The first cruise-button press opens a blinking preview; further presses adjust speed or personality. Off lets the first press make the adjustment immediately.
items.details: The preview shows the selected personality and, when cruise is engaged, the set speed.

items.title: Sub-Mode Visibility Time
items.description: Sets how long the dashboard preview remains visible after a button press.
items.details: Blinking speeds up as the preview approaches its timeout.

panels.label: Cruise
panels.description: Longitudinal control, speed limits, and cruise behavior

items.title: Disengage Cruise on Accelerator Pedal
items.description: Disengages cruise control when you press the accelerator. Off allows a temporary accelerator override.

items.title: Driving Personality
items.description: Choose the following distance and driving response: Aggressive follows closer, Relaxed leaves more space, and Econ favors gentler driving. Standard balances the two.

items.title: Intelligent Cruise Button Management (ICBM) (Alpha)
items.description: Automatically adjusts factory ACC's set speed while the car controls acceleration, braking, and following distance. Off leaves set-speed changes to you.

sections.title: Speed Limits
sections.description: Speed limit detection and offset behavior

items.title: Vision
items.description: Uses the camera's view of the road to reduce cruise speed for upcoming curves. Off disables this additional curve-speed adjustment.

items.title: Acceleration Boost
items.description: Adds acceleration assistance when Experimental Mode falls below the set speed. Off leaves the model's acceleration unchanged; this boost is inactive in Econ and with MVL.

items.title: Map
items.description: Uses map data to reduce cruise speed for upcoming curves. Off disables map-based curve-speed adjustments.

panels.label: Display
panels.description: Screen brightness, timeout, and interactivity settings

sections.title: Brightness & Timeout
sections.description: Screen dimming and sleep behavior while driving

items.title: Interactivity Timeout
items.description: Sets how long the settings screen stays open without interaction.
items.details: The screen closes automatically when this timer expires.

items.title: Screen Saver
items.description: Show a screen saver when the device is offroad and idle, instead of turning the screen off.

items.title: Screen Saver Duration
items.description: How long the screen saver runs before the screen turns off.

panels.label: Visuals
panels.description: HUD overlays, alerts, and on-screen display elements

sections.title: HUD Elements
sections.description: Overlays shown on the driving screen

items.title: Show Blind Spot Warnings
items.description: Shows a warning when the car's blind-spot sensors detect another vehicle.
items.details: Off hides these on-screen warnings without changing the car's blind-spot monitoring.

items.title: Steering Arc
items.description: Display steering arc on the driving screen when lateral control is enabled.

items.title: Display Turn Signals
items.description: Shows turn-signal indicators on the driving screen.

items.title: Display Road Name
items.description: Shows the current road name on the driving screen.
items.details: Requires downloaded OpenStreetMap data for the area.

items.title: Standstill Timer
items.description: Show a timer on the HUD when the car is at a standstill.

items.title: Real-time Acceleration Bar
items.description: Shows the car's measured acceleration and braking on the left side of the driving screen.
items.details: Displays actual vehicle motion rather than the requested acceleration.

items.title: Developer UI
items.description: Display real-time parameters and metrics from various sources.

items.title: Speedometer: Always Display True Speed
items.description: Shows wheel-sensor speed instead of the dashboard-adjusted speed on supported vehicles.

items.title: Speedometer: Hide from Onroad Screen
items.description: Hides the speedometer on the driving screen. Off shows it again.

sections.title: Alerts & Extras
sections.description: Traffic light alerts and visual flair

items.title: Green Traffic Light Alert (Beta)
items.description: Plays an alert when the light turns green and there is no vehicle ahead. Check traffic before proceeding.
items.details: The on-screen notification is available on comma 3X.

items.title: Lead Departure Alert (Beta)
items.description: Plays an alert when you are stopped and the vehicle ahead starts moving. Check traffic before proceeding.
items.details: The on-screen notification is available on comma 3X.

items.title: Tesla Rainbow Mode
items.description: Adds a rainbow effect to the displayed driving path without changing driving behavior.

items.title: Enable sunnypilot
items.description: Use sunnypilot for adaptive cruise control and lane keep driver assistance.
items.details: Use the sunnypilot system for adaptive cruise control and lane keep driver assistance. Your attention is required at all times to use this feature.

items.title: Enable Lane Departure Warnings
items.description: Receive alerts to steer back when you drift over a lane line without a turn signal above 31 mph (50 km/h).
items.details: Receive alerts to steer back into the lane when your vehicle drifts over a detected lane line without a turn signal activated while driving over 31 mph (50 km/h).

items.title: Always-On Driver Monitoring
items.description: Enable driver monitoring even when sunnypilot is not engaged.

items.title: Use Metric System
items.description: Display speed in km/h instead of mph.

sections.title: Recording
sections.description: Camera and audio recording during drives

items.title: Record and Upload Driver Camera
items.description: Uploads driver-camera recordings to help improve driver monitoring. Off stops these uploads.

items.title: Record and Upload Microphone Audio
items.description: Records microphone audio during drives and includes it in dashcam playback on comma connect.
items.details: Off stops recording new audio; existing recordings are unchanged.

panels.label: Device
panels.description: Device behavior, units, and recording settings

items.title: Wake Up Behavior
items.description: Choose whether the device starts normally or stays in Offroad mode after starting or waking.
items.details: Default prepares the device for driving; Offroad keeps driving assistance inactive.

items.title: Max Time Offroad
items.description: Sets how long the device stays on after the car is turned off.
items.details: Battery protection may shut it down sooner; Prevent Automatic Shutdown bypasses both the timer and that protection.

items.title: Disable Updates
items.description: Stops automatic software updates. Restart the device for the change to take effect.

panels.label: Developer
panels.description: Debug tools, remote access, and advanced services

items.title: Enable ADB
items.description: Enables Android Debug Bridge access over USB or the local network.
items.details: Use ADB to access developer tools on the device.

items.title: sunnypilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)
items.description: Replaces factory ACC with experimental openpilot acceleration and braking. This disables factory Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB).
items.details: Off restores factory ACC; changing this setting while the car is on restarts sunnypilot.

sections.title: Test Maneuvers
sections.description: DANGER: enabling these maneuvers replaces normal driving behavior with deterministic test sequences. Each toggle requires explicit confirmation per write. Use only in a closed environment.

items.title: [TEST] Lateral Maneuver Mode
items.description: Replaces normal lateral control with a deterministic test sequence. NOT for road use.

items.title: [TEST] Longitudinal Maneuver Mode
items.description: Replaces normal longitudinal control with a deterministic test sequence. NOT for road use.

items.title: Show Advanced Controls
items.description: Shows advanced settings. Hiding them leaves their current values unchanged.
items.details: Only changes which settings are visible.

items.title: GitHub Runner Service
items.description: Enables or disables the GitHub runner service.

items.title: copyparty Service
items.description: Lets you browse, download, and manage device files in a web browser on the same network.
items.details: Available while the car is off; disabling it stops browser access to the file server.

panels.label: Models
panels.description: Driving model behavior and camera calibration

sections.title: Model Behavior
sections.description: Lane desire and lead-vehicle awareness tuning

items.title: Use Lane Turn Desires
items.description: Uses the turn signal to guide the model's turn direction at low speeds. Off leaves turn selection to the model.
items.details: Applies up to the selected lane-turn speed.

items.title: Adjust Lane Turn Speed
items.description: Set the maximum speed for lane turn desires.

items.title: Live Learning Steer Delay
items.description: Learns the car's steering response time as you drive. Off uses a fixed delay; Firmware Controller uses its own vehicle-specific timing.

items.title: Adjust Software Delay
items.description: Sets the additional steering prediction delay when live delay learning is off.
items.details: Controllers with vehicle-specific timing ignore this value but preserve it for other controllers.

items.title: Adjust Camera Offset
items.description: Adjusts the model's view of the camera position. Positive values shift its center left; negative values shift it right.

items.title: Honda Nidec: Enforce Factory Longitudinal Control
items.description: Uses factory ACC to control acceleration and braking instead of openpilot. Off allows openpilot cruise control.

items.title: Stop and Go for Manual Parking Brake (Beta)
MADS Screen Activation
items.description: Toggle MADS with a multi-finger press on the infotainment screen; more fingers reduce accidental activation. Off resets MADS settings to their defaults.

items.title: Enforce Factory Longitudinal Control
items.description: Uses factory ACC to control acceleration and braking instead of openpilot. Off allows openpilot cruise control.

items.title: Stop and Go Hack (Alpha)
items.description: Enables automatic resume in stop-and-go traffic on supported Toyota and Lexus vehicles. Experimental: be ready to take over.
items.details: Off restores the normal resume behavior.
